notes: No existing destination covers this region (the app has only the standalone border-ranges-national-park, yuraygir-national-park and grafton, unchanged and not re-added). Six destinations are proposed, none added.

Ids continue the earlier curation/nsw northern-rivers run (byron-bay-N, ballina-N, tweed-heads-N, lismore-N, yamba-N), which never reached src/data; gaps (e.g. byron-bay-2, -12 to -15, ballina-4, tweed-heads-3 and -7, yamba-2 and -3) are places that run proposed and this skeptic pass did not keep; do not reuse them. Quill/Lens work keyed to these ids stays valid.

National parks: Nightcap folded into lismore, Wollumbin into tweed-heads, Iluka Nature Reserve into yamba (np_exception in each proposal). Bundjalung National Park is a destination (thin, one spot). Border Ranges NP stays standalone and Toonumbar NP is standalone: neither has a kept sibling, so no park destination. Yuraygir stays the existing standalone (mid-north-coast pass owns it).
Mount Warning is an alias of Wollumbin National Park (named in its bio, aliases field), not a second spot.

Skeptic photos are candidates only: photo_verdict is never 'accept' until Lens. Nightcap (p40 0.13) and Iluka Nature Reserve (p40 0.145) photos are below the brightness floor and need brighten.py; Wollumbin needs a subject point {x:0.4,y:0.4}; Nimbin's photo needs hero crop x 0.35 and has a person at the edge; Wategos is a dusk shot; Byron Bay's header candidate shows the town small.
Seven Mile Beach (Lennox Head) shares a name with a Shoalhaven beach: it needs an explicit WIKI_IMAGE_OVERRIDES photo. Fingal Head's latitude (-28.2) is round: re-run resolve-pin.py before apply.

Mid-north-coast overlap: that pass placed nothing north of Woolgoolga and nothing for Yuraygir, Angourie, Wooli, Grafton or Maclean, so nothing is dropped; this pass places Angourie Point, Maclean and Iluka under yamba and leaves Yuraygir and Grafton as existing standalones. Ulmarra, Brooms Head, Wooli (candidates in this region) were not kept here.

Pins to resolve before apply (coordinates come from skeptic.json OSM via Photon): towns are place=locality/town points (acceptable for a town), the skeptic notes Nimbin's candidate point was 1.5 km north of the OSM village point.
